title: T109 (Tinyana) PNC - Kever ha-Baal Shem Toiv — "Tzaddikim Yirshu Aretz"
hebrewTitle: קבר הבעש"ט — "צדיקים יירשו ארץ" — קדושת ארץ ישראל בקברי הצדיקים
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Siper imi mei-inyan kever ha-Baal Shem Toiv, zecher tzaddik ve-kadoish li-vrachah, she-toiv me'oid li-h'yos sham al kivroi.** Rabbeinu spoke to Reb Nosson *mei-inyan kever ha-Baal Shem Toiv* — that it is *very good* to be there at his grave. **Ve-amar ki "tzaddikim yirshu aretz"** (Tehillim 37:29) — *heinu she-ha-tzaddikim amitiyim yorshim Eretz Yisrael* — **she-zoichin she-mekoim genizasam hu kadoish bi-kdushas Eretz Yisrael mamash, ve-Eretz Yisrael hu tikkun gadol le-pegam ha-bris.** The *makom kevuras ha-tzaddik amiti* is *kadoish bi-kdushas Eretz Yisrael mamash*; and *Eretz Yisrael atzmah* is *tikkun gadol le-pegam ha-bris*. **Two chains, both meeting at one kever**: (a) the kever IS Eretz Yisrael; (b) Eretz Yisrael IS tikkun ha-bris. So *the kever IS tikkun ha-bris*.

intermediate.en: **Rabbeinu al kever ha-Baal Shem Toiv**: toiv me'oid li-h'yos sham. **תה' לז:כט "צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ"** — ha-tzaddikim amitiyim *yorshim Eretz Yisrael* → *mekoim genizasam = kadoish bi-kdushas Eretz Yisrael mamash*. **Eretz Yisrael = tikkun gadol le-pegam ha-bris**. ⇒ *kever ha-tzaddik = tikkun ha-bris*.

scholarly.he: [T2:109א] כבר הבעש"ט — תה' לז:כט "צדיקים יירשו ארץ": מקום גניזת הצדיק קדוש בקדושת א"י ממש; א"י = תיקון גדול לפגם הברית.
